name: toggle-group-49
description: Dashboard card header with a metric toggle group inside a Card component.

files.content: "use client" import * as React from "react" import { Activity as ActivityIcon, Undo as UndoIcon, Users as UsersIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Card, CardAction, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle, } from "@workspace/ui/components/card" import { ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem, } from "@workspace/ui/components/toggle-group" const metrics: Record = { visitors: { value: "48.2k", label: "designali.com visitors this week" }, sessions: { value: "71.9k", label: "Sessions this week" }, bounce: { value: "38%", label: "Average bounce rate" }, } export default function CardToolbarToggleGroup() { const [metric, setMetric] = React.useState("visitors") return ( Traffic {metrics[metric]!.label} next[0] && setMetric(next[0])} > {metrics[metric]!.value} ) }
